method.build: cabal build all --builddir=dist-newstyle-lint; -O1 with strict warning flags

notes: Complete rounds compare frozen pre-Crem input handlers and the original reducer with current full input execution and aggregation, including the capacity policy. The complete/original path calls LegacyHandlers.update and already interprets frozen free ReqTx, ReqSn and AckSn programs. This is not a measurement of introducing Program; the cluster comparison measures the complete design against PR2927.
Recovery compares retained-event application only, without decoding or disk I/O.
No concurrent builds or tests. Tracing disabled. One new transaction, no pending backlog; background sets of 100 and 10000 outputs.
Runs 1-4 are balanced two-second complete rounds, 5-6 are ten-second repeats in both orders, 7-10 are balanced two-second recovery runs.
Interval endpoint combinations are diagnostic bounds, not a joint confidence interval for the ratio.
